meta.title: Birdy — A field journal for birds
meta.description: Identify European birds with your phone camera or mic. 839 species. Offline AI. No accounts.

hero.headline: A *field journal* that looks like a field journal
hero.sub: Identify birds with your camera. Keep what you see. Earn the stamps.

loop.headline: One *loop.*
loop.sub: Four steps. Every sighting closes the circle.

cards.title: Point
cards.body: Open the camera. Aim. The AI guesses three times a second.

cards.title: Match
cards.body: When the confidence locks, the stamp appears.

cards.title: Stamp
cards.body: Your journal gets a new page. Same paper, new species.

cards.title: Browse
cards.body: Flip back any time. Or search 839 European species.

listen.headline: Hear it. *Name* it.
listen.sub: Three seconds. The bird names itself.
listen.body: Hold the record button for 3 seconds. The same on-device AI listens for the bird. Same loop. Same journal. No internet needed.

inside.headline: An *archive* in your pocket.
inside.sub: every european bird, every stamp, every streak

premium.headline: *Free* first.
premium.sub: Premium goes deeper — for the curious few.
premium.body: The app is free. Always will be the core experience. Premium adds PDF-export, seasonal statistics, and 10 field marks for the obsessive collectors.

privacy.eyebrow: PRIVACY · NO PHOTOS LEAVE YOUR PHONE
privacy.headline: Fully *offline.*
privacy.sub: the AI lives in your phone
privacy.body: No cloud. No tracking. No accounts. Just you and the birds.

items.a: Yes. The AI runs entirely on your phone — both for camera and audio. No data leaves the device.
No. Open the app, point the camera, you're scanning. Your journal lives on the phone.
On your device. Birdy never uploads photos to a server. There is no server.
Top-3 accuracy ~72% on European species. Field-verified on a Galaxy S23 Ultra. Confidence shown for every match.
839 European birds — every species in the EBBA2 atlas plus close relatives, with descriptions, photos and range information.
Not yet. Android first. iOS comes after launch if there is demand.
Hold the mic button for 3 seconds. BirdNET-Lite runs on-device, same offline guarantee.
